Exercise 9. a) Thesis: the city is losing trees (and its memory) to widen the streets; you can build roads by preserving trees. Concession: ... ⁧صحيح أن الزحام مشكلة حقيقية، إلا أن⁩ …». Rhetorical question: ⁧ألا يمكن أن نبني الطرق ونحافظ على الأشجار⁩ … ⁧؟⁩ ». Closed: the city builds roads but demolishes a house. Example translation: "City without trees, city without memory." Every summer we discover again what we have always known: our city suffocates. The heat rises, and then we take refuge in the air conditioners, and then the bill of light rises, and then we complain, and then we forget until the next summer. Meanwhile, the municipality continues to tear down secular trees "to widen the roads," as if the solution were in more cars and no more shade. It is true that traffic is a real problem, but a tree cut today needs thirty years to come back. We are not against development and we do not ask to stop the shipyards. Let's ask a simple question: can't you build roads and save trees at the same time? Many cities around the world have done so, and they have lost nothing: they have gained more beautiful and cooler cities. The tree is not an ornament, but part of the memory of the city and the health of its inhabitants. And a municipality that doesn't see it builds roads... but demolishes a house................... b) In the name of God, the Clement, the Merciful. Your Excellency, Mr Ambassador of the Italian Republic, Mr Mayor of the city friend, ladies and gentlemen, kind guests, I am pleased to welcome you to our city, on this day we consider historical for the relations between our two cities. For centuries, trade and the sea have united us; Today, culture and friendship unite us. The twinning agreement we sign today is not just a piece of paper, but the beginning of a collaboration in education, tourism and heritage protection. I would like to thank all those who worked on this project, especially the Italian community of our city and the Arab community of yours, which were a real bridge between the two sides. We hope to welcome next spring the first group of Italian students and send you a group of ours, so that our young people will know each other and discover that what unites us is much greater than what divides us. Thank you for your kind attention. May peace be with you.
